admin_accounts_username_check.name: admin_accounts_username_check
admin_accounts_username_check.value:
"admin_accounts"."username" = btrim("admin_accounts"."username")
    AND length("admin_accounts"."username") BETWEEN 1 AND 80
    AND "admin_accounts"."username" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._@-]+$'

blog_posts_publication_check.name: blog_posts_publication_check
blog_posts_publication_check.value:
("blog_posts"."status" = 'draft' AND "blog_posts"."published_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("blog_posts"."status" = 'published' AND "blog_posts"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

customer_profiles_type_tier_check.name: customer_profiles_type_tier_check
customer_profiles_type_tier_check.value:
("customer_profiles"."customer_type" = 'b2c' AND "customer_profiles"."current_tier" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("customer_profiles"."customer_type" = 'b2b' AND "customer_profiles"."current_tier" IS NULL)
